task: D0 - COLD_PARALLEL_IDENTITY_REGRESSION corrective design, cold worker sweep

measured_operation.timed_region: one perf_counter() immediately before, one subtraction immediately after; nothing else inside
never_called: any cache payload read or write
measured_operation.cache_dir: redirected into D0 scratch; stays empty

forbidden: -Es (Empty System Working Set - the H2 attempt-1 defect)
cold_method.proven_by: H2 two-cycle validation 2026-10-10: cycle A 25646.1->107.1 MB then 98.504s vs 6.648s; cycle B 7559.7->0.5 MB then 99.789s vs 6.675s

run_order_rationale: Balanced rotation taken verbatim from the authorization's example. Each worker count appears exactly once per block and in three different within-block positions (w1: 1,4,2 | w2: 2,5,3 | w4: 3,1,4 | w8: 4,2,5 | w16: 5,3,1), so position-correlated drift cannot favour any single setting. Chosen before any timing was observed and not revisited.

prewarm.purpose: One untimed full identity pass so the fingerprint windows are known to have been touched, guaranteeing slot 1's reset demonstrates warm -> purge -> cold rather than benefiting from an already naturally-cold start. The machine's standby list has been observed to drain spontaneously (H2 R1: 41 GB -> 5 GB in ~6 h), so warmth is established by measurement, never assumed.

per_slot_procedure: RAMMap -accepteula -Et via Start-Process -Wait -PassThru with stdout/stderr redirected; capture exit code and duration
settle 2000 ms, sample memory telemetry again
run the production helper once at the slot's worker count (timed cold run)
immediately re-run the identical call with NO reset (warm control, same worker count)
sample memory telemetry after the run
record parity fields and the ordered-key digest

validity_criteria.note: Reset telemetry is the PRIMARY cold-state authority. Cold/warm timing separation is corroborating evidence only. A slot with a proven reset is NOT invalidated merely because an absolute worker-1-derived timing threshold was not reached - cold absolute time at 2, 4 and 8 workers is unknown and is a discovery of this sweep.

reset_condition_primary.rationale: H2 proved -Et drives standby to 0.3-107 MB from a populated list; the library's own cache footprint is ~7.1-8.1 GB, so a completed preceding run always leaves >5 GB to evict. A 'before' below that means the purge had nothing to do, which is not the validated condition.

corroborating_only.handling: A slot meeting every hard criterion but with cold/warm ratio < 2.0 is retained, counted, and EXPLICITLY FLAGGED in the report as low-separation. It is never silently dropped and never silently kept without mention.

parity_hard_gate.requirement: every valid run at every worker count returns the identical ordered-key digest
parity_hard_gate.on_mismatch: STOP with COLD_POLICY_IDENTITY_PARITY_FAILURE; no corrective design may proceed from unequal identities

analysis_pre_registered: per worker count: cold min/max/median/mean and warm min/max/median/mean, reported separately
cold ratio vs worker 1 and warm speed-up vs worker 1
Pareto frontier: a worker count is DOMINATED if another is no slower cold AND no slower warm with at least one strict improvement; no weighting is applied
multi-scan cumulative cost at 1, 2, 5 and 10 full scans using first=cold median, later=warm median
forbidden_in_d0: any repository file change, branch, commit, push or PR
putting worker count / storage type / cache state / seek penalty into any signature, key, record or contract constant
